comment: Emboss wrap offsets (mitcad#1259) on OCCT. A rod: a circle of diameter 20 (Sketch1 F1) extruded 30 up the Z axis (F2): 100 pi 30. A 4 x 8 rectangle (32 mm^2) wrapped onto it (radius 10) and raised 1 adds 32 * 21 / 20 = 33.6 wherever it goes: Along Axis, Around and Rotation move it and keep its volume. The centre of mass of the body tells where it went: an annular sector of half angle a between radii 10 and 11 has its centroid at 2 (11^3 - 10^3) sin a / (3 (11^2 - 10^2) a) from the axis.

Sketch2 (F3) on XZ (normal +Y, sketch y along -Z), through the axis: a 4 x 8 rectangle from x = -2 to 2 and z = 2 to 10, its middle at z = 6. Emboss1 (F4) with zero offsets is the sketch's wrap: on the +Y side, 4 across (half angle 0.2 rad), 8 along.

Along Axis counts towards +Z and Around turns about +Z, although the rod's cylinder has its axis down, against the extrusion (OCCT's prism). Moved Along Axis by the parameter lift (10 mm), Around a quarter turn (from +Y to -X about +Z) and turned a quarter turn on the face about its middle: 8 across (half angle 0.4 rad) and 4 along, from z = 14 to 18 on the -X side. The same volume.
lift 5: the rectangle from z = 9 to 13, its middle at 11.
The offsets move only wrapped profiles: on the rod's planar end (Emboss2, F5, from Sketch2) they are refused.

expect.error_contains: Along Axis, Around and Rotation move only profiles wrapped
